title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore Auditorium on 1969-12-19
source: 7" Master Soundboard Reels > Cassette > DAT > CDR

ai_review.summary: Soundboard capture of a smoking 12/69 show with standout performances of Cumberland, Hard to Handle and Black Peter as the band burns bright.
ai_review.review: Fans rave that this December ’69 concert is on fire, highlighting powerful renditions of “Cumberland,” “Hard to Handle,” “Black Peter” and an extended “The Other One.” The recording is a soundboard source and is generally praised for its clarity, though one reviewer objects to the track‑splitting of “The Other One.” Overall the energy stays high from start to finish.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high star ratings (mostly 4‑5), strong praise for musical performance and no major complaints about audio quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No specific sound issues mentioned; reviewers note the recording is clear. One comment criticizes splitting The Other One into multiple tracks, but this concerns release format rather than audio fidelity.

show_quality.setlist_flow: High‑energy throughout, with the band staying on fire especially toward the end of the set.
